changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Add menu_category_mapping_id to category_item_mapping, backfill from menu_category_mapping by category_id, add FK and unique constraint with item_id.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE category_item_mapping cim SET menu_category_mapping_id = sub.mcm_id FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (mcm.category_id) mcm.category_id, mcm.id AS mcm_id FROM menu_category_mapping mcm ORDER BY mcm.category_id, mcm.id DESC ) sub WHERE cim.category_id = sub.category_id AND cim.menu_category_mapping_id IS NULL;
